title: Kamishiro Rui — Passionate Prop Making〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Now I just need to tighten the screws.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The cursed flower is a central prop in this show...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The bud, closed as though frozen in time, symbolizes the prince's shadowed heart.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Yes... With this level of polish, the others are sure to like it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay... It's finished.
<Ooh, he said it's finished♪>
<What do you think it's for?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I see I have guests. I didn't notice you there.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehehe, he spotted us!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What brings you all here? Can I help you with something?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We're here to cheer you on!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You're all working so hard every day for the contest, so we wanted to bring you some energy☆>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. That's very kind of you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But you were so focused when we got here that we just ended up watching you work.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you could have said something.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, but we love watching you when you're working on props, Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You always look like you're having so much fun with all the clattering and tinkering♪>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's true, I love these times when I get to sink into my work.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Imagining how each effect will look during a real performance... The surprise on the audience's faces...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Working with my hands while imagining that sight...knowing that my devices will bring it about... I adore this process.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that it's finished, I'm already looking forward to the moment this rose graces the stage.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, right! We were wondering what the flower will be used for.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What kind of scene is it for? It must have some kind of surprise built in, right?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, are you curious?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Maybe I'll have you guess what the surprise might be.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Huh, what could it be?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <It'll be for a fun scene for sure, right? Maybe the flower dances in time with a song!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Ooh, that's so fun! That's gotta be it!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, or maybe it lights up? Just think how pretty it would be if it started shining in the dark!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Ooh, that's gotta be it!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I wanna see it♪>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Those are both wonderful ideas. I'll have to make those sometime soon.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hooray☆>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Huh? But if you want to make them another time, does that mean we didn't get it right?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Then what's the right answer?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The answer is...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, I'd prefer to keep it a secret for now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Aww, why?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because I want you all to see the role this flower plays when we actually put on the show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That way, you'll get to appreciate the surprise inside this flower at the perfect moment for it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hmm, I'm so curious...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But you're right. That's the best time to see it.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay, I'll be patient too!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah! Good luck with the contest, Rui! We'll definitely be there to watch☆>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're putting everything we have into this show. So, we hope you enjoy it.
